sources.snippet: AI Powered Forest Monitoring and Surveillance System Vanrakshak AI is an AI based forest monitoring and surveillance system designed to assist in detecting and monitoring activities in forest environments using Computer Vision, YOLO object detection, and real time camera streams.

sources.snippet: VanRakshak is a smart forest monitoring system developed during HackMela 2026 that demonstrates how hardware sensors and software intelligence can work together to improve forest protection. The project consists of: A hardware prototype representing underground acoustic and environmental sensing units.
